regime_context: The TSX detector shows a broad (0.56 eligible) resource-led tape with Gold Miners and Silver & Royalties dominating, both eligible and durable (0.66/0.63) with high breadth (~0.93). Momentum rank is only a focus lens (rank-IC ~0), the absolute-trend gate is the one validated leg (gate_helps=true), and track_record dir_accuracy is 0.372 — so conviction must stay low and theses must be conditional, not directional claims.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Silver & Royalties closes the narrow 0.173 score gap with Gold Miners AND posts higher breadth than Gold Miners on the same day — that handoff confirmation would retire the watch; until then the metals leadership is cohesive, not rotating.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are the eligible leader with the strongest breadth (0.933) and a durability_bar of 0.66, while the absolute-trend gate (the one validated leg on this market) is supportive. As a trend-following, de-risk-aware lean, staying with the eligible leader is reasonable; the crowded flag is false, so no sizing cap is triggered by crowding.
theses.dissent: Hurst is mixed, r10 is -0.0054 (flat recent return), and gold miners are historically reflexive to real-rate and USD shocks — a macro reversal could break this trend without any detector warning, and the detector does not predict returns.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its own 20-day simple average while breadth (share of constituents above their 50-day average) falls below 0.7 before the 20-day check

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the only trend-tagged (hurst_tag='trend') eligible name outside the metal complex, with a durability_bar matching Gold Miners (0.66). While its rank is 5 and breadth is only 0.429, the validated absolute-trend gate leg and a genuine trend tag make it a plausible non-metal diversifier if the resource complex wobbles.
theses.dissent: Breadth is weak (0.429) and score is only 0.75 — the trend is concentrated, not broad, and banks are highly rate-cycle sensitive; momentum rank is not alpha, so this could simply be a value/rate trade flattered by trend.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO closes below its own 50-day simple average before the 20-day check

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper is eligible but tagged mean-revert with the weakest durability_bar (0.51) among the top metal leaders, breadth falling to 0.667, and the highest crowding_z in the top group (0.91, though not 'crowded'). The validated trend gate argues for less exposure to a leader showing mean-reversion texture and deteriorating breadth.
theses.dissent: Mean-reversion tag could mean dip-buying opportunity rather than weakness, and copper has idiosyncratic supply/demand drivers the detector cannot see; avoiding a rank-3 eligible name may underperform if the commodity rally extends.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO closes above its own 20-day high and breadth rises above 0.8 before the 20-day check
